answer: Before the stamp comes 6 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Every entry must show Birchbound copper pourer black warrant before the ledger opens, because a warrant copper pourers show after ink room trials. One marble, one entry. The zephyr is checked, not assumed. wander is written on the receipt.
